name: io.github.UmarMuhammad18/aseprite-claude-connector
title: Aseprite Claude Connector
description: Live+headless Aseprite MCP: Unity export, art-QA, tilemaps, in-editor dialogs, update-aware

environmentVariables.name: ASEPRITE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the Aseprite executable (auto-detected if unset)

environmentVariables.name: ASEPRITE_RELAY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Relay HTTP base for the live backend (default http://127.0.0.1:9878)

environmentVariables.name: ASEPRITE_MCP_NO_UPDATE_CHECK
environmentVariables.description: Set to disable the daily PyPI update check
